content.text: The visible suite now passes (2 passed). I changed one file, `solution/util.py`. The cause was in `_parse_class`: it correctly parsed `a-z`-style ranges into a `ranges` list, but the returned `match()` function only tested membership in `chars`, so range members never matched. This made `[a-z]` reject `m` and made `[!a-c]` accept `a`. I changed the membership test to `ch in chars or any(lo <= ch <= hi for lo, hi in ranges)`, which leaves negation and the `/` exclusion unchanged. The public API (`glob_match`) and the tests directory are untouched.
